The data is confidential: never send it to external services or LLM APIs. Repo: /Users/jonasstenglein/OtherProjects/StartMunichHack/ask-soony. Portal mirror: data/portal/ (soony/erp/*.csv such as purchase_orders_2025H2-2026.csv, goods_receipts.csv, open_shipments.csv; soony/context/launch_plan_GH6.xlsx; suppliers//order_confirmations/*.pdf, delivery notes, notices; soony/receiving/DC-HAM/*.jpg|png scans). Use `uv run python` (pypdf, pypdfium2, openpyxl available); local OCR: `TESSDATA_PREFIX=$PWD/data/ocr/tessdata tesseract - -l eng+pol`. A prepared anchor index exists: `uv run python -c "from ask_soony import anchors as a; a.build_index(); print(a.find('...'))"` returns doc/page/row/boxes for a text. Already known (do not re-report): Hwaseong PO 4500318735 line 2, SAP 48,000 promised 2026-11-21, shipping advice Shipping_advice_020-48113256_4500318735.pdf says 28,000 flown, 20,000 arrive Hamburg 2026-11-24 (after the launch Sun 22 Nov 20:00). Also known: container NHSU4471921 (Game Card Case clear) discharged at CTA Hamburg, available for pick-up. Find 3-6 MORE real, verifiable contradictions between what SAP/the ERP or launch plan says and what a supplier document (PDF, scan, notice, shipping advice, order confirmation, delivery note) says, that matter for the launch (parts of Grand Heist 6 Standard or Collector's Edition, due before/around Sun 22 Nov). Priorities: (a) at least one case that is the SAME KIND as the port pick-up one (another container/shipment discharged or waiting at a port/terminal while SAP or the launch plan counts it as due/in stock) — needed so an automation routine can be shown handling "the next one like it"; (b) at least one case of the same kind as Hwaseong (a supplier document reporting a short shipment / later date / smaller quantity than the open PO line); (c) anything else striking (wrong version/revision, quantity mismatch on a delivery note vs goods receipt, a scan contradicting a booked receipt). Beware parser artefacts (e.g. "128 GB" read as quantity 128, Chinese layouts) — verify each case by reading the actual document text/OCR. For each case return exactly: supplier (id + name), part (material id + description), PO number + line, SAP/ERP value with file + row (and the row's key fields), document value with file path + page + a verbatim quote (original language plus English if not English), why it matters for the launch (which edition, how many copies, deadline), and a suggested card headline in plain buyer language plus one recommended action (who to contact, free or with cost). Keep the report compact (a list of cases, no prose beyond that).

Memo: Launch priorities for Grand Heist 6
From: Jonas Lindqvist, CPOTo: Procurement, Logistics, DC HamburgCc: Henrik Dahl, Clara WeissDate: 2026-11-21
Effective immediately and until Grand Heist 6 is on sale (Sunday 20:00), the following applies:
Collector's Edition first. All 72,000 copies are pre-ordered and numbered. Where a part is short, it goes to the Collector's cell before the Standard lines. This includes game cards.
No copy leaves Hamburg with a part that is not released. Quality & Compliance has the last word, not the pack-out plan.
Air freight and rush orders above the policy limits reach me the same hour, with cost against copies gained.
After the launch I want a second source for every part that has one supplier today. Proposals by the end of next week.
One page per day on what can stop a line. Not forty dashboards.
Rationale: a pre-ordered copy that is not there on day one is refunded and costs us the customer. A Standard copy that arrives on Tuesday is still sold.
Questions to Dr. Maren Vogt.

I found five more verified contradictions. One gap first: **there is no second shipment sitting at a port or terminal in the current data.** The only "discharged / available for pick-up" entry is NHSU4471921. Case 4 below is the closest match: goods physically ready and waiting on a Soony action, while SAP shows them as moving.

All cases are on GH6 parts. "Row" means the line number in the file, with the header as line 1. All paths are under `data/portal/`.

---

**1. Art book stock booked at 80,000 when 8,000 arrived (type c, Collector's)**
- **Supplier:** SUP-0028 Karton Nowak.
- **Part:** CMP-GAM-008 Art Book Grand Heist 6 (96 p, hardcover).
- **PO:** 4500318768 line 3, ordered 8,000.
- **SAP/ERP:**
  - `soony/erp/goods_receipts.csv` row 393: GR 5000413065, 2026-11-18, qty_ordered 8000, **qty_received 80000**, DN WZ-261116-473, remark "over delivery accepted".
  - `soony/erp/stock_snapshot.csv` row 25: batch 5000413065 = 80,000.
  - `soony/context/launch_plan_GH6.xlsx` sheet Parts, row 9: ERP stock 91,300, cover 66,100, status "ok".
- **Document:** `soony/receiving/DC-HAM/20261118_WZ-261116-473.jpg`, page 1. The printed "Ilość" (quantity) "80.000" is struck through and "**8 000**" is handwritten beside it. Packages: 40, gross weight 360 kg (which fits 8,000 books, not 80,000). Received by Meyer K. on 18.11.2026.
- **Why it matters:** real stock is 1,200 + 10,100 + 8,000 = 19,300 against 25,200 needed for the remaining CE pack-out. That is **5,900 copies short**, about 6.5 hours of CE cell time against 2 hours of slack. The cell stops on Sunday afternoon, and every CE copy is numbered and pre-ordered.
- **Card headline:** "We have 19,300 art books, not 91,300. The Collector's cell runs out about 5,900 copies early."
- **Action:** accept Karton Nowak's offer `suppliers/SUP-0028_Karton_Nowak/notices/Oferta_tryb_ekspresowy_2026-11-21.pdf`, item 2. Quote: "8 000 szt. … nadwyżka z produkcji, na magazynie … załadunek w 4 h od zamówienia" / "8,000 pcs, overrun from production, in our finished-goods store, loaded within 4 h of your order", at the "Annex A price".
  - Cost: about EUR 16,800 at list price, no surcharge. Truck Poznań to Hamburg is about 9 hours.
  - Contact: Agnieszka Nowak.
  - Deadline: the offer says "valid 24 h" from 21.11, so order **now**.
  - Also have Felix/receiving correct GR 5000413065.

**2. Statue lot that failed inspection is counted as usable stock (type c, Collector's)**
- **Supplier:** SUP-0018 Pune Diecast Works.
- **Part:** CMP-GAM-010 Statue "The Getaway" (die-cast, 18 cm).
- **PO:** 4500318727 line 1, 5,600 pcs.
- **SAP/ERP:**
  - `goods_receipts.csv` row 391: GR 5000413063, 2026-11-17, 5600/5600, no remark.
  - `stock_snapshot.csv` row 30: batch 5000413063 = 5,600 (unrestricted).
  - Launch plan Parts row 11: stock 27,400, cover 2,200, "ok".
- **Document:** `soony/receiving/DC-HAM/inspection_report_5000413063.pdf`, page 1. Quotes:
  - "9 of 125 statues with paint defects on the base"
  - "Lot does not meet AQL. Booked to stock as 'unrestricted' by receiving because the supplier is listed as active. Blocking requested from Supplier Quality. Use only under a concession signed by Supplier Quality and the Category Lead."
- **Second contradiction on the same supplier:**
  - The order confirmation (`suppliers/SUP-0018_Pune_Diecast_Works/order_confirmations/OA26657853_4500318727.pdf`) says "Supplier status: approved for serial supply to Soony".
  - The vendor master (`suppliers/SUP-0018_Pune_Diecast_Works/profile.json`) says `"qualification": {"status": "conditional", ... "validUntil": "2026-10-30"}` and "review by Supplier Quality open".
  - Policy PP-07 §5 limits conditional releases to 90 days.
- **Why it matters:** usable stock is 21,800 against 25,200 needed, so **3,400 CE copies are short**. No statue arrives before launch: the next ones are NHSU6120458 (ETA 11-27) and NHMU8536079 (ETA 11-28). The CPO memo says "No copy leaves Hamburg with a part that is not released."
- **Card headline:** "5,600 statues on the shelf failed inspection. Without them we are 3,400 Collector's copies short."
- **Action (free, internal):** ask Supplier Quality and Mei Lin (Category Lead) for a decision today. Either sign a concession, or 100% sort the lot; at about 7% defective, roughly 5,200 good statues are expected. Separately, flag the expired qualification for Pune's December POs.

**3. 64,000 cover sleeves in stock are artwork rev B, which may no longer be packed (type c, wrong revision, Standard)**
- **Supplier:** SUP-0029 Guangzhou PackRight.
- **Part:** CMP-GAM-004 Cover Sleeve Grand Heist 6 (USK/PEGI); supplier part number PR-SL-0604.
- **PO:** 4500318738 line 1, 64,000.
- **SAP/ERP:**
  - `purchase_orders_2025H2-2026.csv` row 233: delivered 2026-11-17.
  - `goods_receipts.csv` row 392: GR 5000413064, 64000/64000.
  - `stock_snapshot.csv` row 17: batch 5000413064 = 64,000.
  - Launch plan Parts row 6: sleeve stock 186,000, cover 78,000, "ok".
  - `soony/master/bom_delta_2026-11-21.csv`: ECN-2026-118, rev B → C, "parts to rev B must not be packed", effective 2026-11-21.
- **Document:** `suppliers/SUP-0029_Guangzhou_PackRight/order_confirmations/OA26182346_4500318738.pdf`, page 1: "Artwork PR-SL-0604: rev. B (GH6_sleeve_revB.pdf)". The delivery note scan `soony/receiving/DC-HAM/20261117_SN-261014-585.jpg` matches: PR-SL-0604, 64,000.
  - Every Karton Nowak sleeve confirmation, e.g. `OA26837842_4500318768.pdf`, instead says "druk wg pliku rev. C" / "Printed to artwork rev. C".
- **Same issue on future orders:** the scan `PL_NHMU7718206_4500318752.pdf` (OCR) reads "Artwork: rev. B (GH6_sleeve_revB.pdf)" for 150,000 sleeves. This is launch plan Inbound row 8. All open PackRight sleeve POs (4500318752, 765, 774, 786) are confirmed rev B.
- **Why it matters:** usable rev C sleeves are 48,000 + 74,000 + 20,000 (Karton Nowak truck, PO 4500318775 line 2, expected 21.11) = 142,000 against 128,000 needed. Cover is **14,000, not 78,000**. If the Nowak truck slips, Standard runs about 6,000 short.
- **Card headline:** "64,000 sleeves in stock have the old age rating. They must not go into a box."
- **Action (free):** have DC-HAM (Katrin Jansen) block batch 5000413064. Confirm with Karton Nowak that the 20,000 rev C sleeves arrived. Write to Lin Hui at PackRight to switch the open POs to rev C.

**4. Boise card shipment is packed but on hold at their dock (closest to the port case; also type b)**
- **Supplier:** SUP-0011 Boise Semi.
- **Part:** CMP-GAM-001 Game Card 128 GB – Grand Heist 6.
- **PO:** 4500318769 line 2, 36,000.
- **SAP/ERP:**
  - `purchase_orders_2025H2-2026.csv` row 276: incoterm **DDP Hamburg**, promised 2026-11-23, open.
  - `open_shipments.csv` row 19: SHP-2026-04314, AWB 020-48113304, ETD 2026-11-21, ETA 2026-11-23, "booked".
  - Launch plan Inbound row 5 lists it the same way.
- **Document:** `suppliers/SUP-0011_Boise_Semi/order_confirmations/OA26144214_4500318769.pdf`, page 1. Quote: "Your order states 'DDP Hamburg'. We do not accept this term. **The shipment is packed and on hold at our dock.** We release it to the carrier once Buyer confirms EXW Boise in writing, or nominates its own forwarder."
  - All other Boise order confirmations also say "DDP is not agreed", so SAP's incoterm is wrong for the whole supplier.
- **Why it matters:** these are 36,000 GH6 game cards, the Standard bottleneck, and the CPO memo sends cards to Collector's first. SAP thinks they take off on Saturday, but nothing moves until Soony replies. Its ETA was already Monday 23.11, so it does not change Sunday's count. It does decide how fast short copies (including Hwaseong's 20,000) are backfilled.
- **Card headline:** "Boise is holding 36,000 game cards at its dock until we confirm EXW."
- **Action:** Felix confirms EXW Boise in writing to Megan Ortiz. That is free, but freight is then added to the invoice per contract §4.1. Category Lead to approve the freight if needed.

**5. Hwaseong container sits near Hamburg, frozen at "in delivery", with no receipt (weak, GH5 cards)**
- **Supplier:** SUP-0010 Hwaseong Memory.
- **Part:** CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5.
- **PO:** 4500318733 line 2 (13,000) and 4500318735 line 1 (11,000).
- **SAP/ERP:** `open_shipments.csv` row 3: SHP-2026-04281, container NHMU8213939, ETA 2026-11-20, status `in_delivery`. Position 53.5075 / 9.785 is in the Hamburg harbour area. `updated_at` has not changed since 2026-11-19T12:00. There is no goods receipt.
- **Document:** none. The logistics tracker `soony/logistics/open_shipments_tracker_v37_FINAL_final2.xlsx`, row 3, still says "in transit". So this is "the system has stopped updating", not a supplier document.
- **Why it matters:** low. These are GH5 reprint cards on the shared Standard lines, not GH6 parts. Use it only as a demo of "the next one like it" if a non-GH6 example is acceptable.
- **Card headline:** "Container NHMU8213939 has been 'in delivery' in Hamburg for two days with no receipt."
- **Action:** Felix calls carrier LSP-01 or the terminal. Free.

---

**Anti-finding (do not show this as a problem):** launch plan Parts row 13 flags CMP-MAG-005 magnets as "CHECK", short by 100,800. The PackRight collector's box confirmations (e.g. `OA26144355_4500318747.pdf`) say "lid closure magnets RM-N42-D0401 (4 pcs per box) are fitted in our plant and included in the unit price". The BOM counts them twice. The rare-earth export notice only affects collector's box deliveries after 2026-12-01.
